schemas.name: scalar_root_int
schemas.shows: The boring case: a document is a bare integer. If this doesn't work, nothing else will.

schemas.name: record_stable
schemas.shows: Still boring, also load-bearing: every document is the same four-field record with all fields required. The most ordinary case there is.

schemas.name: record_optional
schemas.shows: One required field, three optional. The analyzer needs to mark fields nullable from per-doc presence, NOT spawn variant arms over the optional ones.

schemas.name: map_uuid_keys
schemas.shows: Keys are UUIDs — data, not metadata. The record-view drops, a wildcard gets injected, and the leaf shape under the wildcard is recovered by pooling. The whole point of the dual-view design.

schemas.name: tuple_heterogeneous
schemas.shows: Fixed-arity [string, f64, i64, bool] tuple. Tuple-vs-bag detection has to win on tight arity AND keep per-position type purity across mixed scalar types.

schemas.name: polymorphic_array_discriminated
schemas.shows: Each array element is one of three discriminated event shapes. The Space-Saving subtree cluster sketch has to surface all three as variant arms instead of collapsing them into one struct with everything optional.
